# superlog_synthetic_check (Resource)

An HTTP check that requests a URL on a schedule and checks the response. After `failures_to_alert` failed runs in a row it posts to its Slack channel, and posts the recovery in the same thread.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "health_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "superlog_synthetic_check" "api_health" {
  name              = "API health"
  url               = "https://api.example.com/health"
  interval_seconds  = 60
  failures_to_alert = 2

  headers        = { Accept = "application/json" }
  secret_headers = { Authorization = "Bearer ${var.health_token}" }

  assertions = [
    { kind = "status_code", op = "eq", value = "2xx" },
    { kind = "json_path", key = "$.status", op = "eq", value = "ok" },
    { kind = "response_time", op = "lt", value = "1500", severity = "degraded" },
    { kind = "certificate_expiry", op = "gt", value = "14", severity = "degraded" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `url` (String) The full HTTP or HTTPS URL to request.

### Optional

- `assertions` (Attributes List) Checks on the response. Without any, a run passes when the request completes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assertions))
- `body` (String) The request body. Not for `GET` or `HEAD`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) A disabled check does not run. Defaults to `true`.
- `failures_to_alert` (Number) Failed runs in a row before the check posts to Slack, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 1.
- `follow_redirects` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.
- `headers` (Map of String) Request headers by name.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) How often the check runs: 60, 300, 900, 1800, or 3600 seconds. Defaults to 300.
- `method` (String) Defaults to `GET`.
- `retries` (Number) Immediate retries before a run counts as failed, from 0 to 2. Defaults to 1.
- `secret_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Request headers stored encrypted, such as `Authorization`. Superlog never returns their values, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `slack` (Attributes) The Slack channel the check posts to. Look it up with the `superlog_slack_channel` data source. Without one, the check only records its history in Superlog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--slack))
- `timeout_ms` (Number) From 1000 to 30000. Defaults to 10000.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `web_url` (String) The check in Superlog.

<a id="nestedatt--assertions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assertions`

Required:

- `kind` (String) `status_code`, `response_time` (ms), `header`, `body`, `json_path`, or `certificate_expiry` (days).
- `op` (String) `status_code` takes `eq`, `neq`, `lt`, `gt`; `response_time` `lt`; `header` `eq`, `neq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `exists`, `not_exists`; `body` `contains`, `not_contains`; `json_path` all of these; `certificate_expiry` `gt`.

Optional:

- `key` (String) The header name for `header`, or the JSON path for `json_path`, such as `$.status`.
- `severity` (String) A failed `critical` assertion fails the run; a `degraded` one marks it degraded. Defaults to `critical`.
- `value` (String) Compared with the response. A status code may be a class such as `2xx`.


<a id="nestedatt--slack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `slack`

Required:

- `channel_id` (String) The Slack channel ID.
- `integration_account_id` (String) The Superlog Slack integration the channel belongs to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a check by its ID, from its URL in Superlog. Secret header values
# are not returned, so the first apply after an import sets them again.
terraform import superlog_synthetic_check.api_health 55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555
```
